variants.text: The footings are hollow and the way in is barred, and the bar is on the far side. The toll post kept a tally of everything that crossed this bridge, and three of its years are in a different ink.
A bridge over nothing, standing on footings, and the footings ring hollow the whole way round.
The hum comes up through the stone here rather than down off the span. It has been coming up the whole time.
